current.text: Javon Small is on a two-way contract with Memphis.
He is behind Ty Jerome, Scotty Pippen Jr. and Cam Spencer on the guard depth chart.
Ty Jerome has started both preseason games at point guard, and Memphis is giving him a big role.
Coach Tuomas Iisalo is expected to run an 11 or 12 man rotation, which spreads minutes even thinner for players at the end of the bench.
The experts expect him not to play most nights, so he is not relevant for fantasy this season.

durable.text: He has shown he can play as a real NBA rotation point guard.
He ranked about 100th in fantasy after the trade deadline last season.

note: Do not draft him. Yahoo values him at 0 USD and ranks him 342nd, ESPN does not list him, and the experts say a two-way player behind Jerome, Pippen and Spencer will not play most nights. Last season he scored 9.7 points with 3.7 assists in 20 minutes and finished about 100th after the deadline, so he can produce if he gets minutes. Check early in the season whether he signs a standard contract or an injury hits the Memphis guards, and leave him on waivers until then.
